description: Get setup info for Rudow's client SDKs (Node.js backend, Python backend) — package name, install command, a minimal config/usage snippet, and how to obtain a project ingest API key. Use this to help a user add logging to their own codebase: install the right package for their stack and write the snippet into their code yourself — this tool only returns information, it does not install anything or touch the user's files. Ingest keys come from create_ingest_key (or create_project), if your connection has write access; see key_instructions in the result. Write the key to the app's .env as RUDOW_API_KEY.
name: list_sdks
